subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt runtime metadata parity only, with prompt-driven selective reply routing left to existing host routing/message-tool policy or a separate API follow-up?
rationale: The metadata omission is source-confirmed and narrow, but letting prompts choose delivery channels affects deterministic routing, message delivery policy, and channel/plugin contracts.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Keep or open a separate issue for explicit channel-selective reply API and product design after the metadata gap is fixed.

options.title: Rely On Existing Routing Policy
options.body: Close or narrow the broader selective-routing ask after documenting that host-controlled routing and message-tool policy are the supported path.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement only normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()`.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared command prompt bundle history and latest maintainer scoping comment make this the clearest owner for the metadata-versus-routing decision.
